note: Positive and defeating cases for contracts/authority-grant.schema.json and the evaluator in scripts/sovkernel/authority.py. Two cases prove a live grant covers a request; nineteen prove a refusal, and every refusal code the evaluator can report has at least one case proving it actually fires. Each case is a patch over base_grant and base_request, so what a case says is exactly what it changes; a field a case does not mention is the base value, and a field neither mentions is absent rather than satisfied.

cases.proves: The whole point of the standing grant: a change inside scope, on an admitted branch, under budget, with a green verify and lint and an independent CONFIRMED observation, lands without a fresh conversation.
A ceiling admits every class at or below it. A RECORD_LOCAL commit is covered by a RESOURCE_CONSUMPTION grant; the ceiling is a maximum, not an equality.
Writing a grant is not the same act as switching it on. A grant at PROPOSED standing is inert, so a participant cannot author its own authority into effect.
A grant is exercised by the actor it names and by nobody else.
Scope is per capability. A grant that can land cannot thereby ratify; the capability list is exhaustive.
Revocation refuses visibly (SPEC.md, PROD-I-5), and refuses on its own without waiting for the expiry.
A grant issued for a future window does not reach backwards.
A standing grant that never has to be renewed stops being a decision. Past valid_until it refuses, and nothing in the loop can extend it.
An exclusion beats an inclusion. decisions/ sits under no included prefix and is excluded besides, so the loop cannot record its own policy.
The registry sits under contracts/, which the grant otherwise admits. Excluding it by name is what stops an exercise of the grant from widening the grant it is being exercised under.
Scope is an allow list, not a deny list. A path nobody thought to exclude is still outside the grant unless a prefix admits it.
The branches a grant names are the branches it reaches. A grant to land on main is not a grant to land anywhere.
An over-budget grant refuses visibly (SPEC.md, PROD-I-5). A run that sprawled past its envelope stops at the landing gate rather than at nothing.
A RECORD_LOCAL grant does not stretch to cover resource consumption merely because the work is otherwise in scope.
JUDGEMENT authority may be issued by the owner alone. A participant that writes itself a judgement grant has written nothing.
Phase FOUNDING admits no external-world effect, and the phase refuses before any grant is consulted. No grant can be written that gets around it.
A build cannot witness itself. A landing request carrying only its own green checks is a self-report, and the gate says so.
An observation that exists but does not confirm is not an observation the gate can stand on. Only CONFIRMED counts.
A helper that read or edited the change is inside the build and can never witness it (AGENTS.md, Closure ownership). The gate refuses the substitution rather than trusting the label.
A check the request does not mention is absent, never satisfied. Silence is not a pass.
main stays releasable. A failing repository check stops the landing at the gate, not at review.
